en: A black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a busy fairground or exhibition area. People in 1920s clothing walk along a wide dirt path toward a central pavilion-style building with a hipped roof, large windows, and striped awnings. Crowds are gathered around the building, which appears to be a restaurant or café. Smaller pavilions and flagpoles with flags surround the main structure, with low hills visible in the background. Handwritten-style white text is printed at the bottom of the image.
